title: ¡ALTO, Tito! ¿Y tus manos? 🧼🥞 | Canciones Infantiles #Shorts
world: warm wooden kitchen (mint tiles, orange accents): table with finger paints and pancakes + sink with step stool
story: Tito's hands are covered in finger paint and he reaches for the pancakes (problem)
Mamá raises her trunk: ALTO! Tito freezes (conflict)
Tito looks at his palms: paint and tiny silly germ creatures (discovery)
Off to the sink on a little stool, Mamá pumps the soap (the try)
Rub rub: giant foam and rainbow bubbles (the habit)
Splash rinse: the paint swirls away, germs wave bye (climax)
Clean sparkling palms shown proudly, Mamá claps (reward)
Pancakes together; Tito sneaks a look at the paint pots again (loop gag)
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡ALTO, Tito! ¿Y tus manos?
[Verse]
¡Uy! ¡Pintura y bichitos!
Al lavabo, ¡vamos ya!
Agua y jabón, ¡qué espuma!
[Chorus]
¡Frota, frota, frota!
¡Splash! ¡Se van, se van!
¡Manitas limpias!
[Outro]
¡Ahora sí, a comer!
style: High-end 3D animated preschool cartoon style, soft rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte clay-like materials, soft studio lighting with a warm key light, pastel but saturated colors, big expressive glossy eyes, cute and friendly, clean composition, high quality render.
lock: TITO, a baby elephant toddler. Powder-blue body, very big round ears with peach-pink insides, short soft trunk curled up at the tip, big glossy dark-brown eyes with white sparkle highlights, rosy cheeks, a tiny tuft of three hairs on top of the head, wearing small sunny-yellow overalls with one round red button, short chubby arms and legs, small tail.
mama_lock: MAMÁ ELEFANTA, the mother of the baby elephant: a gentle grown-up adult elephant with motherly adult proportions, clearly taller and slimmer than a toddler, longer legs and a longer graceful trunk, soft lavender-grey body, big round ears with peach-pink insides, warm brown eyes with long eyelashes, a kind smile, wearing a soft lilac dress with tiny white polka dots, a white apron, and a small yellow flower behind one ear.

locations.mesa: A cozy warm kitchen, vertical 9:16 composition, camera at child eye level: a round wooden kitchen table with a big sheet of paper covered in colorful finger-paint splashes, three small open pots of red, blue and green finger paint, and a white plate with a tall stack of fluffy pancakes topped with strawberries and honey; mint-green wall tiles, orange curtains on a sunny window, a potted plant. Nobody is in the kitchen.
locations.fregadero: A cozy warm kitchen sink corner, vertical 9:16 composition, camera at child eye level: a white kitchen sink with a shiny tap, a small wooden step stool in front of it, a round soap pump bottle with pink soap, a fluffy orange hand towel on a hook, mint-green wall tiles, a sunny window with herb pots on the sill, warm wooden cabinets. Nobody is in the kitchen.

shots: Extreme close-up: the baby elephant's two little hands completely covered in bright red, blue and green finger paint, reaching toward a stack of fluffy pancakes with strawberries in the foreground; his excited hungry face with wide eyes just behind his hands.
His paint-covered hands reach slowly toward the pancakes, his eyes sparkle with hunger.

Medium shot at the kitchen table: Mamá Elefanta stands tall and holds up her trunk like a friendly stop sign with a gentle surprised face; the baby elephant freezes mid-reach with his paint-covered hands in the air.
Mamá raises her trunk to say stop; the baby elephant freezes and blinks.

Close-up: the baby elephant looks down at his open palms covered in colorful finger paint; on his palms sit four tiny cute round green fuzzy germ creatures with silly little faces, dancing; his eyes are wide with surprise.
The tiny green germ creatures wiggle and dance on his palms; he leans back surprised.
Wide shot of the kitchen sink corner: the baby elephant climbs onto the little wooden step stool in front of the sink, Mamá Elefanta stands beside him and presses the soap pump bottle.
The baby elephant steps up onto the stool; Mamá presses the soap pump, pink soap comes out.

Close-up, camera very close to the sink at the baby elephant's chest height: the baby elephant stands on the step stool behind the white sink, only his head, shoulders and two little round hands visible; his hands rub together inside a big fluffy cloud of white soap foam, rainbow soap bubbles float up around his happy face.
His hands rub round and round inside the foam, the foam grows and rainbow bubbles float up past his smiling face.

Close-up, camera very close to the sink at the baby elephant's chest height: the baby elephant holds his foamy hands under the shiny running tap, clear water splashes on his hands, colorful red, blue and green paint swirls into the white sink basin in a little rainbow whirl, he laughs.
Water splashes on his hands and the colorful paint swirls around the sink basin and away; he laughs.

Close-up, camera very close at the baby elephant's chest height in front of the sink: the baby elephant holds up both clean pale-blue round hands with the palms facing the camera, little white sparkles twinkling around his hands, a big proud happy smile.
He holds up his clean hands proudly and wiggles them, the sparkles twinkle.
Medium shot at the kitchen table: the baby elephant and Mamá Elefanta sit together, the baby elephant takes a big happy bite of a fluffy pancake with a strawberry, Mamá smiles at him.
He takes a happy bite and wiggles with joy; Mamá smiles warmly.
Wide shot of the kitchen table: the clean baby elephant with a full belly glances sideways at the three pots of finger paint and slowly reaches one finger toward the blue pot with a mischievous grin.
He slowly reaches one finger toward the paint pot with a sneaky grin.
